ig_caption:
Kubernetes CPU throttling: your pod is Running, 0 restarts... and painfully slow 🐢

⚠️ CPU limit: 50m (5% of one core)
⚠️ Kubernetes doesn't kill a pod for using more CPU. It throttles it.
→ 5.8 s per answer. No crash, no alert, every dashboard green. Worse than dead, because nobody notices.

The fix:
✅ a CPU request the app really needs
✅ a realistic CPU limit (or none at all)

Same request → 0.2 s.

Do you set CPU limits? Tell me 👇 Follow for more Kubernetes breaks.

#kubernetes #k8s #devops #sre #performance
yt_title: Kubernetes CPU throttling: Running, 0 restarts, still slow #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real run on a local kind cluster: a CPU-heavy API with limits.cpu: 50m answers in 5.8 s while the pod shows Running with 0 restarts. CPU over the limit is throttled (CFS quota), not killed, so nothing alerts.
Fix: requests.cpu: 500m and a realistic limit (cpu: "1"): the same request answers in 0.2 s.

Memory over the limit = OOMKilled. CPU over the limit = throttled.

Series: Kubernetes in production, what breaks (live). Follow for more.

#kubernetes #k8s #devops #sre #cputhrottling
